mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in over 60% of months with UNRATE below 3.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is less than 0.01 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruption regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply constraints, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in over 55% of instances when INDPRO declines during supply chain disruptions, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (y/y) signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates and generates negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL above 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 above 2.0%) indicates a robust economy, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in over 55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 2.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) raises discount rates for equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in over 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises during tightening cycles, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02.
